description: Header file defining the 'Clearcut' class with static methods for sending various device events for metrics collection, related to Android emulator/host commands in the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: Clearcut
classes.description: Class providing static methods to send various device metrics events such as VM start/stop, device boot, lock screen.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Private static method to send an event with specified device and event types.

methods.name: SendVMStart
methods.description: Public static method to send a VM start event.

methods.name: SendVMStop
methods.description: Public static method to send a VM stop event.

methods.name: SendDeviceBoot
methods.description: Public static method to send a device boot event.

methods.name: SendLockScreen
methods.description: Public static method to send a lock screen event.
